title: National Commission must monitor State Commissions' performance
description: The National Commission has administrative control over State Commissions to monitor their performance

content.what: shall monitor performance of the State Commissions
conditions: by calling for periodical returns regarding institution, disposal and pendency of cases
limitations: without interfering with their quasi-judicial freedom
